title: A Cover for the Ghost
premise: Lior Blackwood, a crash investigator haunted by the unexplained death of her family in row twelve, receives a meeting invitation from a handler who died three years ago. Following it, she uncovers a conspiracy inside the agency that rewrote the rules she's lived by — and learns a new 'accident' is scheduled within days, engineered by the same people who erased the truth about row twelve. As Lior races to stop the attack, she must decide whether loyalty to the found family of colleagues who raised her matters more than exposing what they did. In the end, she prevents the crash but chooses truth over protection, publishing the row twelve files and burning her old life down to build an honest one.
about_author: Ulyana Marchetti is a former aviation safety analyst who traded hangars for hardcovers after a decade of reading black-box transcripts. She writes thrillers about people who follow rules until the rules betray them.

chapters.title: Invitation from the Dead
chapters.summary: POV: Lior. Three years after losing her family in row twelve, crash investigator Lior Blackwood receives a calendar invite from her dead handler, Marek Voss, for tomorrow at 9 a.m. She verifies it isn't a hoax — his credentials are live, his voice on a voicemail fresh. Torn between grief and instinct, she goes. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into suspicion as the past refuses to stay buried.

chapters.title: The Rules Keep Rewriting
chapters.summary: POV: Lior. At the meeting site Lior finds not Marek but Dana Okonjo, a junior analyst who claims Marek sent the invite before dying — again — last week. Together they discover the agency has been quietly editing accident reports, including Lior's own family's file, to mask a pattern of engineered crashes. Someone flags their access; they flee with a partial archive. Emotional beat: paranoia blooming, and the first fragile bond of trust with Dana.

chapters.title: Row Twelve, Revisited
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Lior and Dana. Decoding the archive, Lior learns row twelve was targeted — her family was collateral in a sanctioned operation, and the next one is scheduled in forty-eight hours: a charter flight staged as mechanical failure. Her mentor, Director Hale, who taught her every rule, is implicated. Confronting him, she's offered protection in exchange for silence. Emotional beat: loyalty cracking against truth; betrayal at its most intimate.

chapters.title: What the Black Box Keeps
chapters.summary: POV: Lior. With hours left, Lior and Dana leak the flight plan, forcing a ground stop, while Lior confronts Hale aboard the delayed charter and records his confession via the cockpit's data link. The attack collapses; Hale is arrested, but the agency closes ranks. Lior releases the full row twelve files publicly, ending her career and her silence. Emotional beat: costly resolution — truth chosen over belonging, and a new family forged with Dana in the aftermath.
